title: Raising Lazarus

scenes.title: The One You Love Is Sick

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Jesus was across the Jordan River, in the place where John had first baptized, when a message came.

bsb: This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.
kjv: This sickness is not unto death, but for the glory of God, that the Son of God might be glorified thereby.

bsb: Let us go back to Judea.
kjv: Let us go into Judea again.

bsb: Let us also go, so that we may die with Him.
kjv: Let us also go, that we may die with him.

puzzle.prompt: When Jesus heard Lazarus was sick, how long did He stay where He was?

bsb: Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died. But even now I know that God will give You whatever You ask of Him.
kjv: Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died. But I know, that even now, whatsoever thou wilt ask of God, God will give it thee.

bsb: Your brother will rise again
kjv: Thy brother shall rise again.

bsb: I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.
kjv: I know that he shall rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

bsb: I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies. And everyone who lives and believes in Me will never die. Do you believe this?
kjv: I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live: And whosoever liveth and believeth in me shall never die. Believest thou this?

bsb: Yes, Lord
I believe that You are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.
kjv: Yea, Lord: I believe that thou art the Christ, the Son of God, which should come into the world.

puzzle.hint: It means coming back to life.

bsb: I am the resurrection and the life.
kjv: I am the resurrection, and the life:

bsb: Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
kjv: Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

bsb: Where have you put him?
kjv: Where have ye laid him?

bsb: See how He loved him!
kjv: Behold how he loved him!

bsb: Take away the stone
kjv: Take ye away the stone.

bsb: Did I not tell you that if you believed, you would see the glory of God?
kjv: Said I not unto thee, that, if thou wouldest believe, thou shouldest see the glory of God?

bsb: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus lifted His eyes upward and said,
kjv: Then they took away the stone from the place where the dead was laid. And Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said,

bsb: Father, I thank You that You have heard Me. I knew that You always hear Me, but I say this for the benefit of the people standing here, so they may believe that You sent Me.
kjv: Father, I thank thee that thou hast heard me. And I knew that thou hearest me always: but because of the people which stand by I said it, that they may believe that thou hast sent me.

bsb: Lazarus, come out!
kjv: Lazarus, come forth.

bsb: The man who had been dead came out with his hands and feet bound in strips of linen, and his face wrapped in a cloth.
kjv: And he that was dead came forth, bound hand and foot with graveclothes: and his face was bound about with a napkin.

bsb: Unwrap him and let him go
kjv: Loose him, and let him go.

puzzle.prompt: Put the story of Lazarus in order.

events.text: The sisters send word that Lazarus is sick
Martha meets Jesus outside the village
Lazarus comes out of the tomb

puzzle.hint: It begins with a message from the sisters.

bsb: I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
kjv: I am the resurrection, and the life: he that believeth in me, though he were dead, yet shall he live:

bsb: I am the resurrection and the life.
kjv: I am the resurrection, and the life:

reflect: Jesus wept with His friends, and then He showed He has power even over death.
discuss: Jesus knew He would raise Lazarus, but He still wept. What does that tell us about how He feels when we are sad?
Martha said, “I believe that You are the Christ.” What does it mean to believe in Jesus?
Jesus said He is the resurrection and the life. Why is that good news for people who have lost someone they love?
prayer: Jesus, You are the resurrection and the life. Thank You for caring when we are sad. Help us believe in You. Amen.
